title: ACTREC Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 04 Nurse, Clinical Research Coordinator and Other Posts
description: The Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of 04 Nurse, Clinical Research Coordinator, and Data Entry Operator Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in any degree, B. Pharm, B.Sc, M.Sc, M.Pharm, GNM, or B.Sc Nursing can use this chance and apply for the TMC Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply ...
